MRI Information
The Rhea Stent is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5 Tesla only when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- Any receive-only coil may be used.
- Whole-Body SAR ≤ 2 W/kg.
- Maximum active scan time of 15 minutes.
- A cooling period of 5 minutes is required between scans.
Scan regions: Head Only.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
